structured.answer: I'd hold it in a פסגות trading account and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the page says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום" after fees and tax, from 135,000 ₪ put in. It assumes 2% inflation a year.

stuck.where: אינפלציה button next to the sliders
stuck.why: I only found the inflation assumption because the task told me to look. It hides behind a small grey button, and the main screen only says 'בכסף של היום'.

stuck.where: Fund type tags (צוברת 16, חשיפה לדולר 19, עסקת החלף 5...)
stuck.why: Too many options that look alike, all in words I don't know. Without the ★ הזול star I'd have done nothing.

stuck.where: Second pair, only −122 ₪ worse, also פסגות
stuck.why: Made me unsure whether choosing between them even matters.

findings.what: The inflation assumption (2%) is hidden behind a small button. The main result only says 'בכסף של היום'.
The 'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל' condition sits right under the big number, and a beginner can't judge it.
Many fund-type tags in jargon with counts. It's overwhelming.
